naturalSyntaxLs.serverPath.description: Path to the natural-syntax-ls binary. Leave empty to use the bundled binary for the current platform.

naturalSyntaxLs.filetypes.description: VSCode language IDs to activate natural-syntax-ls for.

enumDescriptions: dependency: diaparser UD parser (default for dependency)
naturalSyntaxLs.model.description: Which model to use, meaning depends on naturalSyntaxLs.mode. Export the matching model first with scripts/setup.ps1 -Model <name> (or scripts/export_model.py --model <name> --mode <mode>) — file names are derived from this value, so it must match what you exported.

naturalSyntaxLs.tokenMapUpdate.description: POS tag overrides. Key = tag (e.g. CC), value = {type, modifiers} or null to disable.

naturalSyntaxLs.scoreThreshold.description: Minimum confidence score (0–1) for a token to be highlighted. Defaults to 0.333 if unset.

naturalSyntaxLs.wiktionaryDefinitions.description: Show Wiktionary definitions in hover tooltips.

naturalSyntaxLs.semanticLightness.description: OKLCH lightness for semantic mode colors (0–1). Increase for light themes, decrease for very dark themes.

naturalSyntaxLs.semanticChroma.description: OKLCH chroma (color intensity) for semantic mode colors. Higher = more vivid.

naturalSyntaxLs.mode.description: Highlighting mode. 'pos' colours by part-of-speech (default). 'semantic' clusters words by contextual meaning — run scripts/export_model.py --model <mpnet|minilm> first. 'dependency' colours by Universal Dependencies relation and draws head/dependent arcs — run scripts/export_model.py --model <diaparser-catalog-name> first (e.g. en_ewt.electra-base).
